contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Call, WhatsApp or visit us — we are happy to help with your order.

home.whyFamilyBody: For over 30 years, the Nagarajan family has brought quality rice varieties and traditional food products to customers.
home.whyBrandsBody: ANANTHI is the main brand. ARTHY, SANTOSH and MAHI are the sub-brands.
home.whyRangeBody: The range includes everyday rice, biryani rice, hand-pounded rice, traditional rice, sevai, millets and flour.
home.whyPlacesBody: Direct sales and the head office are in Paramakudi. Home delivery is available for selected Paramakudi and Chennai pincodes. A branch office is in Ramapuram, Chennai. Orders can also be sent on WhatsApp.
home.step1Body: Select a variety and a pack size. Products are listed in 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 26 kg.
home.step2Body: Add the product to the cart, or send the same details on WhatsApp.
home.step3Body: Enter your home delivery pincode. If it is one of the Chennai or Paramakudi pincodes, add your full address and phone number, then continue to payment.
home.step4Body: When the pincode and address are complete, choose a payment method.
home.deliveryRadius: Home delivery is available for selected Chennai and Paramakudi pincodes. Enter the pincode at checkout.
home.whatsappBody: Send a message to ANANTHI RICE. Products already in the cart are included.
home.heroLead: Everyday rice, traditional varieties, millets, sevai and flour from our family brands — carefully selected and delivered to your home.
home.trustYearsBody: A family business serving customers for three decades
home.trustWhatsappBody: Send your whole order in one message
home.categoryLead: From daily meals to festive biryani — find the right grain.
home.brandsLead: One family, four brands — each with its own speciality.
home.orderLead: Ordering takes just a few minutes.
home.deliveryLead: Free home delivery for selected Chennai and Paramakudi pincodes. Enter the pincode at checkout.
home.faqLead: Quick answers to common questions about our rice, delivery and ordering.
